Name: Ladder Outline
Author: ogahalo00
Description:
[size=4][b]LadderOutline[/b][/size] is a quality-of-life mod inspired by [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/22052]Ladder Light[/url] and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/3094]Ladder Locator[/url]. In addition to drawing high-visibility outlines around ladders and shafts, it features [b]smart directional pointers (arrows)[/b] that point directly to all revealed ladders and shafts on your floor—even when they are far off-screen!

Never wander blindly in the dark or lose track of where a ladder or hole spawned after a bomb explosion again!

[line]

[size=4][b]🌟 Features[/b][/size]
[list]
[*] [b]🎯 Directional Pointers (Arrows):[/b]
[list]
[*] Smart arrow indicators pointing towards active ladders and shafts.[/*]
[*][b]Screen Edge Mode:[/b] Pointers stick to screen borders when targets are off-screen, complete with distance display (e.g. 15m).[/*]
[*][b]On-Screen Markers:[/b] Floating, bouncing arrows appear above ladders/holes when they enter your viewport.[/*]
[*][b]Player Orbit Mode:[/b] Optional arrows circling your farmer pointing towards each exit.[/*]
[*][b]Multi-target Support:[/b] Displays multiple pointers simultaneously if multiple ladders or holes appear.[/*]
[/list][/*]
[*][b]🕳️ Full Support for Shafts (Holes):[/b] Separate detection and distinct customizable colors for ladders (green) and shafts (cyan).[/*]
[*][b]🎨 Customizable Outlines:[/b] Highlights ladder and shaft tiles with customizable colors, opacity, and thickness.[/*]
[*][b]🌐 Full Translation Support (i18n):[/b] English ([i]default.json[/i]) and Vietnamese ([i]vi.json[/i]) included out of the box. Community translations are warmly welcomed![/*]
[*][b]⚙️ In-Game Configuration:[/b] Fully integrated with [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu (GMCM)[/url].[/*]
[/list]
[line]

[size=4][b]🛠️ Installation Guide[/b][/size]
[list=1]
[*] Make sure you have [b]Stardew Valley 1.6+[/b] installed.[/*]
[*]Install the latest version of [b][url=https://smapi.io/]SMAPI[/url][/b] (3.18.6+ / 4.0+).[/*]
[*]Download this mod and extract the [b]LadderOutline[/b] folder into your [b]Stardew Valley\Mods[/b] folder.[/*]
[*][i](<Optional but recommended>)[/i] Install [b][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url][/b] for easy in-game settings.[/*]
[/list]
[line]

[size=4][b]⚙️ Configuration (config.json)[/b][/size]
You can configure everything in-game via GMCM or by editing [i]config.json[/i]:

[code]
{
  "EnableMod": true,
  "ToggleKey": "None",
  "DebugMode": false,

  "EnableOutline": true,
  "OutlineColor": "Green",
  "ShaftOutlineColor": "Cyan",
  "OutlineOpacity": 0.6,
  "OutlineThickness": 3,

  "EnablePointer": true,
  "PointerStyle": "ScreenEdge",
  "ShowOffscreenOnly": true,
  "ShowOnscreenMarker": true,
  "ShowDistance": true,
  "ShowTargetType": true,
  "LadderPointerColor": "Green",
  "ShaftPointerColor": "Cyan",
  "PointerScale": 4.0,
  "PulseAnimation": true
}[/code]
[list]
[*] [b]EnableMod:[/b] Master switch to turn the mod on or off.[/*]
[*][b]ToggleKey:[/b] Hotkey to toggle the mod during gameplay (e.g. "F6" or "None").[/*]
[*][b]PointerStyle:[/b] "ScreenEdge" (screen borders), "PlayerOrbit" (around farmer), or "Both".[/*]
[*][b]ShowOffscreenOnly:[/b] If true, screen-edge arrows only appear when the ladder/shaft is outside your screen.[/*]
[*][b]ShowOnscreenMarker:[/b] Shows a floating bouncing arrow above ladders/holes when visible.[/*]
[*][b]ShowDistance:[/b] Displays distance in meters/tiles next to the arrow.[/*]
[*][b]ShowTargetType:[/b] Displays "Ladder" or "Hole" label next to the arrow.[/*]
[*][b]LadderPointerColor / ShaftPointerColor:[/b] Available colors: Green, Cyan, Yellow, Red, Blue, Purple, Orange, White, Pink.[/*]
[*][b]PulseAnimation:[/b] Smooth bobbing/breathing effect for arrows.[/*]
[/list]
[line]
